issues.check: Check hinge fit, free travel and brace tab orientation. Final balance/rigging remains outside this manual. Check each elevator independently, then repeat after joining horns, tensioning brace wires and connecting cables. Isolate any stage that introduces binding; do not copy the article's shim fabrication, balance additions or -4 degree tail setting.
